method: All in-game FP spend as burn: shop consumeds (ex-upgrades) × list FP + dice×0.2 + loot×($2.0/FP_USD) + pass×($15.0/FP_USD)
unit: FP (catalog list price + USD/FP for loot/pass)
note: lifetimeFpBurned sums Shroom/shields/insurance/cosmetics shop buys (list FP), dice (0.2 FP), lootboxes ($2/FP_USD), passes ($15/FP_USD). Upgrade items 1–5 excluded (stake). NOT pet.fpSpent / stakedFp. Catalog & FP_USD are snapshots; historical costs may differ. Wheel/gacha treated as free (no FP in docs). Scans consumeds itemIds 0–64; unknown ids listed in unpriced* (not summed). V1 foods (beer/apple/tea/…) are not distinct itemIds in api.pet.game.
